verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own Search API docs state it returns results 'with controls for domains, languages, regions,' which directly addresses localizing by language and region. That is a single summary-level mention: no parameter names, accepted values (e.g. country codes), granularity, or examples are shown. Nothing shows the same localization applies to the Sonar or Agent answer endpoints. missing for 10: documented parameter names and values for country/language/location, finer-grained location (city/coordinates) support, evidence of localization on Sonar/Agent answer endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
